results.title: Delaware senator calls on NFL to explain handling of Jalen Hurts health issue
results.description: Conflicting reports suggest Mr. Hurts was hospitalized and advised to stay awake until kickoff as a safety precaution. He played, but a follow-up ultrasound days later found the clot had moved.

results.title: Pennsylvania warns of congenital measles amid 'increase of measles cases during pregnancy'
results.description: The Pennsylvania health department issued a warning to doctors Monday about an increase in measles cases during pregnancy, along with rising concern about congenital measles, a disease rarely seen in the U.S.
